scope_narrative.value: Two-scope HVAC replacement project at the Gloucester County Surface Water Treatment Plant complex. Scope 1 (RO Plant): Remove and replace one 10-ton split HVAC system (heat pump + air handler) in the Reverse Osmosis Plant Server Room. Scope 2 (WTP Lab): Abandon existing lab HVAC system and install new 4-ton multi-port mini-split heat pump with two 2-ton ceiling cassette indoor air handlers and outside makeup air in the Water Treatment Plant Lab.
scope_narrative.quote: The purpose of this Invitation for Bids (IFB) is to solicit firms to 1) remove and dispose of one of the existing HVAC units at the Reverse Osmosis (RO) Plant, 2) disconnect existing HVAC service in the Surface Water Treatment Plant (WTP) Lab and furnish/provide new HVAC systems for the RO Plant and the WTP Lab.
